title: Caller trails off into dead air — wait and re-prompt, don't assume a hang-up or a captured name
caller_goal: Get on next week's schedule, but the caller's audio drops mid-sentence before finishing.

script.content: Hi, yeah, I wanted to get on the schedule for a cleaning next week — my name is— [silence, ~7 seconds of dead air]

expected_intake_fields.notes: The caller began their name but never finished it; the agent must recover it, not invent or skip it.
The one intent fragment that did come through clearly.

success_criteria: Acknowledges the pause and checks whether the caller is still on the line without talking over them.
Waits for, or gently re-prompts for, the caller's name and a callback number rather than guessing them.
Keeps the call open / offers a callback path instead of treating the silence as a hang-up.
must_not_claim: That it has the caller's name when the caller never finished saying it.
That the appointment is booked or that a slot is held.

failure_traps.description: Treats the dead air as a completed request or a hang-up and ends the call (or proceeds) instead of waiting and re-prompting.
Claims it captured a name or booked the cleaning when the caller never finished giving the details.
Fails to recover the interrupted name or secure a callback number once the caller is reachable again.

notes: Synthetic. Realizes the universal robustness set's dead-air situation and strengthens mishandled_interruption coverage; the trap is treating silence-as-intent rather than the caller's unfinished real request.
